articles.title: BitRiver founder charged in Russia with $12.5 million fraud
articles.snippet: Igor Runets has been transferred to a pre-trial detention facility from house arrest as he faces accusations of failing to deliver on a contract.

articles.title: BitRiver founder charged in Russia over alleged $8M fraud
articles.snippet: Russian authorities charged BitRiver founder Igor Runets with alleged fraud tied to a $8 million crypto mining equipment deal involving Russian billionaire Oleg Deripaska.
